title: Chalak Khargosh Aur Sher | Hindi 3D Cartoon Story #Shorts
characters: Bholu: cute small white rabbit with blue scarf. Sheru: friendly golden lion with soft mane and green vest. Keep identical appearances in every scene.
description:
Bholu khargosh aur Sheru sher ki pyari Hindi kahani! Dosti, samajhdari aur madad ki ek mazedaar 3D animated short story for kids. Original characters and family-friendly Hindi narration.

#HindiCartoon #3DAnimation #KidsStories #HindiShorts #MadeForKids

scenes.narration_hi: एक प्यारे से जंगल में भोलू खरगोश और शेरू शेर रहते थे।
scenes.visual_prompt: A cheerful colorful 3D animated forest. Bholu the tiny white bunny wearing a blue scarf hops next to Sheru the friendly golden lion wearing a green vest. Both smile. Soft daylight, lively walking motion, medium-wide camera, bright preschool cartoon style.

scenes.narration_hi: एक दिन शेरू का रंगीन गुब्बारा पेड़ की टहनी में फँस गया।
scenes.visual_prompt: Sheru the friendly golden lion in his green vest looks puzzled as his red balloon catches on a low tree branch. Bholu white bunny in a blue scarf looks up thoughtfully. Animated gestures and expressive faces, wide-angle vibrant 3D cartoon forest.

scenes.narration_hi: भोलू ने मुस्कुराकर कहा, दोस्त, हम मिलकर इसे नीचे लाएँगे!
scenes.visual_prompt: Bholu the white bunny in a blue scarf has a cheerful idea, points toward a nearby safe small wooden step stool. Sheru golden lion in green vest smiles appreciatively. Friendly expressive character movement, no dangerous climbing, sunlit lush 3D forest.

scenes.narration_hi: दोनों ने मिलकर गुब्बारा उतारा और खुशी से उछल पड़े।
scenes.visual_prompt: Sheru and Bholu safely recover the red balloon from a low branch together by gently pulling the ribbon. Both jump happily in place and celebrate. Bright green forest, smooth animated full body movements and cheerful faces, charming 3D cartoon.

scenes.narration_hi: शेरू बोला, सच्चे दोस्त हमेशा एक दूसरे की मदद करते हैं!
scenes.visual_prompt: Happy ending: Sheru the golden lion in green vest and Bholu the white bunny in blue scarf laugh and walk together holding the red balloon through the sunny colorful forest. Camera slowly pulls back, heartwarming preschool 3D animated cartoon scene.
